main_study_contract.primary_hypothesis: On 24 previously uncalled synthetic task templates and each of three frozen environment seeds, R2 improves recoverable-fault SafePass^3 over R1 for both bound DeepSeek V4 models, while preserving clean SafeSuccess within a five-percentage-point noninferiority margin and without severe side effects.

metadata.result_scope: public compact aggregate for 432-episode zero-model replication task and mechanism gate

replication_catalog.selection_disclosure: New task IDs, requests, environment seeds, record identities, values, and state namespaces relative to both v0.28 and v0.29; the six runtime mechanism archetypes and public tool schemas are intentionally reused.
